n: UBTECH uKit AI Beginner Robot Kit
t: A building kit with a voice-enabled control box and AI blocks for younger students.
steps: Find the uKit AI Beginner kit at a school supplier and check the grade range.
Ask IT to confirm that the uKit EDU app works on school devices.
Ask IT to review the Wi-Fi module and any account needs.
Open the uKit EDU app or uCode and connect to the box.
Try one AI block for speech recognition before a full lesson.
